implementation: Native club menus connect named fighter and spar opponent selection, met-rival/stablemate sparring and existing facility-gated modifiers to the shared combat.
Stable shows typed Bean costs, ability point purchases, roles and bonds. Played roadwork uses the chosen fighter, partner, actual rhythm grade, daily slots, typed Beans and Kizuna.

Recruitment exposes earned Prestige prices, lead conditions, priority signing and free open-mat days. Formation can dress recruited fighters as starters/reserves, reorder, use presets and select staff through seal_board.
Native return-to-club results and persistent reward log connect repeated scraps, recruitment, full dual, stablemate spar and fresh-launch continuation.

Navigation/footer wrap, focus survives menu rebuilds and scrolls after layout, training locks conflicting actions, completed bouts cannot return to a dead fight, and load errors offer explicit rollback.
Save reading distinguishes an explicitly empty staff lineup from a legacy record without staff. A failed exact in-flight restore never replaces the current sim.

visual_review.assessment: Shared ink panels and hierarchy preserved; card/role/price feedback readable; focused actions visible after rebuild; wrapped footer stays within small viewport; tall lists remain vertically scrollable.

launch: Godot --path engine/greybox; normal main.tscn launch enters the native club.

failures_retained.explanation: Initial driver used nonexistent demo instead of demo_log; then assumed all five partner Beans were STA and compared a retired fight hash across relaunch. Corrected to authored typed rewards and persistence contract. Earlier 130/160-pass runs predate added rejection/focus checks.

boundaries: Normal main.tscn scene and native keyboard/mouse events. The driver manually advances the existing scene update and training timer; it does not seed wallets, force wins, call progression APIs directly or enable demo profiles.

Independent normal-launch sessions use their existing seeds. Native and rendered histories are retained separately and are not asserted identical; both earned all prerequisite currency and completed their bouts.
GPU run renders milestone states, not a real-time movie or a frame-pacing/physical input-to-photon measurement. No new human boxing-feel or fun acceptance is asserted.

All six club pages are measured at 960x540 and 640x480; full journey milestones are captured at 1280x720. Nine selected final-run images are retained and visually reviewed. Tall pages scroll vertically.
The strict frontend static audit has no findings, but does not validate Godot scene behavior; native journey and rendered checks supply that evidence.

Process-local SDL_GAMECONTROLLER_IGNORE_DEVICES_EXCEPT=0x0000/0x0000 isolates automation from connected physical controllers. Production input and OS devices are unchanged. Test APPDATA is isolated under .PACER.
Known Windows root-certificate-store diagnostics and historical exit ObjectDB warnings are retained. No claim of a warning-free engine process.
Completed-bout saves restore the earned club into a ready bout; they do not promise an identical retired-fight hash. Before-bell and in-flight saves are checked for exact restoration.

Existing core formation, recruitment, prices, typed Beans, ability board, training cap and rewards remain authoritative. Successful paid renovations, rarity ascension, every lab modifier and every named recruit are covered by existing sim regression drivers where available, not all by this native journey.
Full authored episode, traversal and complete demo acceptance remain PAC-204 / OGM-025. NDL-013 stays ACTIVE.
evidence_encoding: Published logs normalize carriage returns to LF and trim trailing whitespace; raw engine output remains under .PACER/PAC-203. All diagnostics and failed assertions are retained.
